notes.title: Sail Forth is out now!
notes.content:
We're so excited to announce that Sail Forth is OUT NOW on Steam!

Master semi-realistic sailing physics to chart unknown waters in a heartfelt journey to save the world! Put the wind to your back and cast out into a vast ocean spanning dozens of eccentric regions. Discover countless isles bursting with their own flora, fauna, friendly folk, and fearsome foes. Playfully pursue a pod of curious dolphins, admire the beauty of the sun sinking into an icy horizon, or run down a clutch of cowardly criminals only to accept their apologies to the tune of wild cannonry. Will you answer the call of High Adventure?

Get it for 10% off now through December 28!

notes.title: KUR IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]KUR is available right now for everyone to play.[/b]

Thanks to everyone who has followed all our development updates, showcase appearances, streams, and demo events - KUR is out now and ready for all of you to play. We've got a long list of things we'd love for you all to experience across all 23 levels, a huge arsenal of weapons, and the hordes of robotic flesh-wearing enemies. 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1706288137437804250/94B6FF1EE566EE376CACD95155DA2FD2B8A6978C/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

We've released KUR as an Early Access title in order to give Really Ragdoll more time to polish the game and work with the community to implement changes. The game is content complete with over 20 levels, and we're looking forward to making the game the best it can be along with all of your help.

This comedic take on the classic ‘90s shooter lets you put the boot to your enemies - literally - you can slide and kick your way out of most situations, and if that doesn't get your totally real human blood pumping there's always the shrink ray that lets you shrink enemies and punt them into gloriously gibby explosions of limbs and microchips. Fight drones, spider robots made out of the skulls of their victims, mutated giants with nuclear waste barrel hammers, and even more! We’re pretty sure you fight a sentient meatball that is also a train conductor at one point. Each level is filled with pure WTF moments and excellent classic fps gameplay all to the beat of a pulse-pounding electronic rock soundtrack. Embrace the early ‘90s and not-quite-old-school gaming tropes all while upgrading yourself to be the best, most badass, space mercenary you can be.

[b]Now, buy the s***ting game already![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243520/KUR/

notes.title: Pick up the QAG Games Collection bundle for 20% off!
notes.content:
Get all of QAG's amazing games for a great discount of 20% off! There's hundreds of hours of playtime in classic award-winning indies like The Bridge, Tumblestone, and more. Save the world in light-hearted action adventure games The Ambassador: Fractured Timelines and Space Otter Charlie. Blast off into high scores with twin-stick shooters Breakpoint and #Funtime. Break your brain with tricky platformers Deleveled and Almost There!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21865/QAG_Games_Collection/

[b]Space Otter Charlie[/b] is a zero-g puzzle platformer where you explore derelict space stations, battle unhinged robots, and enjoy some otterly terrific puns as you jump, float, and fly through over a dozen levels of furry fun.

[b]Breakpoint[/b] is a twin-stick slasher where your weapons explode. Break through the swarm to claim your spot on the online leaderboard.

[b]Deleveled[/b] is a platformer with no jump button! Preserve your potential energy and fall to new heights as you solve these clever puzzles and maneuver your way to victory.

[b]The Ambassador: Fractured Timelines[/b] is a twin-stick fantasy shooter where you freeze time, outsmart your enemies and reverse the annihilation of your home.

[b]#Funtime[/b] is an explosive twin-stick shooter where shooting isn't your only weapon. Swap your ship's color to destroy enemies, avoid damage, and ultimately control the battlefield.

[b]Almost There[/b] is a precision platformer where everything wants to kill you! With over 150 stages and timed challenges, Almost There will kill you thousands of times.

[b]Tumblestone[/b] is the first original action-puzzle game of the past fifteen years - completely reinventing the genre into a deep and cerebral puzzle solving experience that you won't forget.

[b]The Bridge[/b] is a logic puzzle game that forces you to reevaluate your preconceptions of physics and perspective. Manipulate gravity to redefine the ceiling as the floor while venturing through impossible architectures.

notes.title: Update notes for April 5, 2021
notes.content:
This update fixes a few bugs that crept in to the initial release. Thanks to everyone who reported an issue! Hopefully this makes things a little more stable everyone - don’t hesitate to let us know if you find anything else! 
[list]
[*] [b]Fix[/b]: In top level of Verituf Labs, it was possible to get multiple copies of the same key - possibly resulting in a crash or inability to progress.
[*] [b]Fix[/b]: Multiplayer games were incorrectly reporting a Draw when two or more of the losing players had identical scores.
[*] [b]Fix[/b]: Crash on startup for some players, related to certain peripherals being connected at startup.
[/list]

notes.title: Space Otter Charlie is Out Now with a 20% off Launch Discount!
notes.content:
[b]Venture forth into the great unknown, where no otter has gone before![/b]

Head out into space to find a new home for Charlie and the whole animal kingdom! Charlie and his crew of otternauts need your help to find a planet suitable for all the animals left behind from humanity’s grand exodus. In Space Otter Charlie you’ll shoot, slide, and jetpack your way through all sorts of obstacles - but watch out for ARES! They’re the Anti Rodent Elimination System trying to keep you from scavenging all the parts you need. It’s not all mechanical menaces blocking your way, you’ll need to dodge debris, exposed wiring, and dangerous jets of flame to build up an arsenal worthy of your adventures. Lazors, Shark suits, and more are available with the help of your buddy Build Bot - so make sure you grab all the junk you can find! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364869/2a91c7ce7607f03487e8ecd375ff7a1f7a7f2f8d.png[/img]

The Space Otter Charlie development team is a group of familiar faces from the glory days of PopCap. Joining former global studio head of PopCap Ed Allard, we have Jeff Weinstein (AstroPop, Bookworm Adventures, Zuma's Revenge) on code, Matt Holmberg (PvZ, Peggle 2, Feeding Frenzy, Magi Nation) on pixels, and Isaac Aubrey (Space Tyrant, Forza, Bejeweled Blitz, Motor City Online) on level design. It’s a tiny team working on something that’s otter this world! With an absolutely stellar pedigree, Wayward Distractions is happy to bring you all out into otter space! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364869/079b892bb435892139a2f1d3a81d67c039333c93.png[/img]

[b]As we are a small team, every single review helps us out a ton - so drop by and let us know what you think![/b]

notes.title: Meet the Team behind Space Otter Charlie!
notes.content:
You're about to become one of the galaxies fuzziest explorers!

Wayward Distractions has partnered with The Quantum Astrophysicists Guild to release the zero-g puzzle-platformer Space Otter Charlie in early 2021. The Wayward Distractions team is a group of veteran devs from the glory days of PopCap Studios. Joining former global studio head of PopCap Ed Allard, we have Jeff Weinstein (AstroPop, Bookworm Adventures, Zuma's Revenge) on code, Matt Holmberg (PvZ, Peggle 2, Feeding Frenzy, Magi Nation) on pixels, and Isaac Aubrey (Space Tyrant, Forza, Bejeweled Blitz, Motor City Online) on level design. It’s a tiny team working on something that’s otter this world!

[url=https://youtu.be/1Naz9Qku6Xg][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1768194233235195846/0506D9F55F4ADCC37F9D69A9357982C50016203C/[/img][/url]      [url=https://youtu.be/1Naz9Qku6Xg][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1768194233235200226/E067285ECE29FF6101227CF43AB663582C94AEBE/[/img][/url]

[b]Here’s what Studio Head Ed Allard of Wayward Distractions had to say about creating Space Otter Charlie:[/b]

[i]“While I was playing around with zero-g prototypes, the fluid motion reminded me of Feeding Frenzy, which was the first game I created like a hundred years ago. I’m not the first person to realize this connection - NASA trains astronauts for spacewalks under water. I started thinking that sea creatures could probably adapt more quickly to the strangeness of Zero-G than humans could. Blend that realization with a zero-g game prototype and a long time love of sea otters, and you’ve got Space Otter Charlie.”[/i]

[url=https://youtu.be/1Naz9Qku6Xg][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1768194233235304360/2051DB0966CCDC19D8D782026AFF8B2A4434C126/[/img][/url]
[b]Unique Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Use all your abilities to pull off trick shots and take on enemies
[*] Channel your inner otter to “swim” through zero gravity and jetpack through dangerous new areas
[*] Enjoy local multiplayer modes with up to 3 friends
[*] Craft new weapons, upgrades and wacky spacesuits to help you tackle puzzles and enemies
[*] Learn more about your furry friends with fun facts as you explore
[/list]

We hope you're all as excited as we are about the upcoming release of Space Otter Charlie! We'll have more news to share soon.

notes.title: 2020 Sucks So Bad Otters Are Our Only Hope
notes.content: In a galaxy left wrecked by humankind, it’s up to some optimistic sea mammals to head out into… otter space. Join Charlie the space otter astronaut and friends on a puzzle platformer adventure to save the Earth! Uniquely adapted to the “float” of zero gravity, otters are the perfect solution to all space-related problems.

notes.title: Who Knew Cleaning Up Mankind’s Mess Would Be This Adorable?
notes.content: Humankind has abandoned the galaxy. There’s a chance for the solar system to thrive again but you’ll have to join a team of optimistic sea mammals and head out into… otter space! Space Otter Charlie is a puzzle-platforming adventure about a team of otternauts dedicated to saving what’s left of Earth. When you think about it, otters are the perfect animals for daring space missions and exploration. The “float” of zero gravity is similar to the sea after all, and otters have all the qualifications (actually having thumbs) that other animals don’t! Join Charlie and his team to solve puzzles, explore space, and bring the galaxy back together.
